title: Yellowed Garlicky Vietnamese Lasagne Sheets Cha Gio
description: A garlicky, shaggy, one-pot Vietnamese dish featuring lasagne sheets, binchotan-charcoal, and flexitarian-friendly ingredients, formed into cha gio, Vietnamese spring rolls.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add the julienned carrots and sliced mushrooms and cook until they start to soften.
Add the cooked mung bean noodles, soy sauce, and fish sauce, and stir to combine.
Add the dried lasagne sheets to the skillet, breaking them into pieces as they cook.
Use the binchotan charcoal to add a smoky flavor to the dish.
Continue cooking the mixture until the lasagne sheets are well coated and the mixture is heated through.
Serve the Yellowed Garlicky Vietnamese Lasagne Sheets Cha Gio hot, garnished with chopped herbs if desired.
